intro.body: I build enterprise back-end systems with Java and Spring, most recently for digital banking and government platforms. I care about data integrity, query performance, and systems that stay predictable under load.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I am a back-end developer with a degree in Information Engineering from Universitas Gadjah Mada. Most of my work lives in Java and Spring, backed by PostgreSQL — building the parts of an application that have to stay correct when nobody is watching.
about.p2: Outside of work I am an avid gamer and a movie enthusiast who values time with friends and family. I am also learning more about investment instruments — stocks, bonds, and mutual funds — to understand financial markets a little better.
